subject: Rescheduling Redwood demo — FY budget refresh & travel conflicts
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Oliver Chen <oliver@fintechco.com>, Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@fintechco.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood demo — timing for FY budget update

Hi Oliver / Sarah,

Thanks again for the time last week — really excited to show how Redwood can help reduce inference cost and give predictable latency for your fraud-detection workflows. Per our conversation, I wanted to lock in a 45-minute demo with the engineering and procurement teams.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Thu Sep 9, 10:00-10:45
- Fri Sep 10, 13:00-13:45
- Mon Sep 13, 09:00-09:45

I know you mentioned you're entering a quarter-end budget refresh; if it makes sense to push until after your FY reset we can also look at week of Sep 20. If procurement needs to join, happy to include a short pricing/commitments section.

AGENDA (draft):
- Short intro & objectives (5m)
- Demo: inference runtime, cost/perf controls, routing (25m)
- Pricing & procurement path (10m)
- Next steps / MAP (5m)

Happy to adjust. Looping in Laura to help with any alignment on commercial cadence.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0192

Attachment: agenda-stub.pdf (1 page)

From: Oliver Chen <oliver@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@redtechco.com>, procurement@fintechco.com
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 14:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — timing for FY budget update

Hi Marissa,

Thanks — appreciate the clear agenda. Quick heads-up: a few of us are traveling next week for customer site visits, and finance just announced a temporary spend freeze as they close our Q3 books. That means procurement & finance wants to avoid new commitments until the FY budget reset around mid-September.

Can we push the demo to the week of Sep 20? Preferably Sep 21 or 22 after 11am PST — that gives finance time to finish the close and lets the right stakeholders (legal/procurement) join.

Also: would you be able to share a short mutual action plan and a draft quote ahead of that meeting so procurement can pre-review?

Thanks,
Oliver
Head of Engineering, FinTechCo
oliver@fintechco.com | +1 415-555-4010

Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — timing for FY budget update

Oliver / Sarah — thanks for the update and totally makes sense to wait until after the freeze.

Sep 21 or 22 after 11:00 PST works on our side. Proposed firm slots (PST):
- Tue, Sep 21, 11:30-12:15
- Tue, Sep 21, 14:00-14:45
- Wed, Sep 22, 11:30-12:15

Laura — looping you in to confirm we can (a) share a brief mutual action plan and (b) provide a draft quote the team can pre-review with procurement. Neha from Solutions will join the demo to cover technical questions and integration timelines.

Oliver — to make procurement's review quicker, we'll send:
- short mutual_action_plan.pdf (MVP deliverables, milestones, decision owners)
- draft quote (term options + committed capacity)

If any of those times conflict, tell me which of the three works best and we'll lock it.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Oliver Chen <oliver@fintechco.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 15:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — timing for FY budget update

Hi Oliver — glad we can shift to align with your budget cycle. Sep 21, 11:30-12:15 PST is confirmed on our side.

I've attached a short mutual_action_plan.pdf and a draft quote (quote-draft-RDW-FT-043.pdf) for procurement to review. The quote includes two options: 6-month reserved capacity commitment and a pay-as-you-go pilot — both with expected cost per inference estimates and SLA notes. We'll keep the demo focused on the pilot path and the integration checklist so procurement can see a low-risk entry.

Agenda will be the same as Marissa outlined; Neha will demo the integration story and I'll cover commercial terms for 10 minutes.

Next steps:
- Marissa to send calendar invite to the confirmed slot (done).
- Oliver / Sarah to share list of procurement/legal attendees.
- Procurement to review attached documents and flag any redlines before the meeting.

Thanks and talk soon,
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales, Enterprise | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com | (650) 555-0123
